QUOTE: when `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is not defined, the macro expands to `private_##member` ... Defining it before the headers are included makes `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expand to the real name `x`

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both the default rename to private_<member> and that defining the gate makes the macro expand to the unchanged member name.
